title: Numbers With Same Consecutive Differences
summary: Given two integers n and k , return an array of all integers with exactly n digits where the absolute difference between every two consecutive digits is k .
statement: Given two integers n and k , return an array of all integers with exactly n digits where the absolute difference between every two consecutive digits is k . Ensure that the integers do not have leading zeros.
constraints: Return all n-digit integers with no leading zero whose adjacent decimal digits differ by exactly k.
Order does not matter and duplicates are forbidden.
hints: Build numbers from a nonzero leading digit.
At each step only last+k and last-k can be legal next digits; use a set to merge them when k=0.
The recursion explores every locally required next digit and no other value.
editorial: The recursion explores every locally required next digit and no other value.

tests.explanation: The valid results repeat one nonzero digit: 11 through 99.
